name: VOiCES: Voices Obscured in Complex Environmental Settings
description: The VOiCES (Voices Obscured in Complex Environmental Settings) corpus is an acoustic dataset designed to advance far-field automatic speech recognition and robust speaker verification in noise. Recorded by SRI International and Lab41 across four real reverberant rooms with background distractors (television, music, room babble), it contains 19,000 multi-channel audio recordings capturing 300 speakers under complex acoustic conditions.
